focus_timer.title: Break reminder
focus_timer.description: Offer timed break reminders only after activity since the previous tick.

lead_with_answer.title: Lead with the answer
lead_with_answer.description: Start with the answer and keep the necessary explanation brief.

lead_with_answer_max_chars.title: Maximum characters
lead_with_answer_max_chars.description: Response character limit; zero leaves it unset.

lead_with_answer_max_lines.title: Maximum lines
lead_with_answer_max_lines.description: Line limit used to count long answers.

offer_options.title: Compare options
offer_options.description: Compare several options before recommending a choice.

offer_options_max.title: Maximum options
offer_options_max.description: Present no more than this many options.

offer_options_min.title: Minimum options
offer_options_min.description: Present at least this many options.

one_next_step.title: One next step
one_next_step.description: Split large tasks and finish with one concrete next action.

plain_language.title: Plain language
plain_language.description: Use plain language and explain necessary technical terms.

publish_guard.title: Ask before publishing
publish_guard.description: Block matching Bash publish commands until a timed grant is set; other tools and scripts that publish internally are outside this guard.

publish_guard_allow_minutes.title: Grant duration
publish_guard_allow_minutes.description: Minutes a publishing grant remains valid.

publish_guard_patterns.title: Guarded command patterns
publish_guard_patterns.description: Regular expressions checked against Bash commands.

respect_stop_signals.title: Respect stop signals
respect_stop_signals.description: Acknowledge a stop signal and end without another task or question.

respect_stop_signals_phrases.title: Stop phrases
respect_stop_signals_phrases.description: Match a whole utterance with only trailing punctuation, whitespace and up to six characters of Japanese particles, ahead of fragment acknowledgement.

running_indicator.title: Show ongoing work
running_indicator.description: Show elapsed time and tool activity, with a notice for long turns.

session_resume_brief.title: Brief session history
session_resume_brief.description: On resuming, show only days since the last session and its turn count.
